pages.text: Cuts, fells trees, strips logs and scrapes copper.\n\nPut the material in your $(l)offhand$() and hold right-click to saw. Shift + right-click cycles the recipe when several match.

pages.title: Felling trees
pages.text: Shift + left-click a log to fell the whole tree.\n\nThis can be turned off in config ($(c)enable_tree_felling$()). Breaking is done with player context, so protection plugins, statistics and enchantment drops all behave normally.

pages.title: Recipes it can do
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Cutting$() recipes$(br)$(li)$(l)Stonecutting$() as fallback$(br)$(li)Exclusive saw recipes from datapacks\n\n$(italic)Only 1 durability per cut, no matter how many items the recipe yields.$()

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)The tooltip shows the currently selected recipe index.$(br)$(li)Batch crafting enchantment processes multiple items at once.$(br)$(li)Saplings and leaves aren't touched when felling.
